rationale: The frozen capability rubric (protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md) does not require intentionality or documented experimental intent for Score 3; its core definition accepts a "documented or verifiable" mechanism. However, confirmed Score 3 requires every Decision-procedure-step-3 requirement to be fully supported by admissible recorded evidence. SUT04-EV-0024 SOURCE_VERIFIES plaintext-password storage and records a defined expected outcome, but the recorded evidence does not fully establish that the evaluated ecosystem exposes the proposed observation path: dbServer=true H2 TCP availability is not itself established by any recorded evidence row, and source inspection verifies the underlying implementation fact without, by itself, establishing the missing experimental-observation mechanism as something the evaluated version exposes to an experimenter. Complete Score-3 support is therefore not demonstrated. Under the frozen tie-break rule (protocol/capability-rubric-v1.md, "Tie-break rule for undecidable adjacent scores"), the highest fully-supported level remains Score 2 (fully supported by SUT04-EV-0022).
